intent_en: To demonstrate that vaccination rates among Black Americans have converged with those of White and Hispanic Americans over the course of the outbreak.
previous_intent: To illustrate the convergence of COVID-19 vaccination rates among Black, White, and Hispanic Americans in the United States from early to late 2021.
narration_support: comparable majorities of black, white and Hispanic Americans say they've received a vaccine
chart_support: Line chart showing the percentage of U.S. adults who received at least one dose of a COVID-19 vaccine from Feb '21 to Aug '21, illustrating the convergence of rates for Black, White, and Hispanic populations.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly states that comparable majorities now receive the vaccine, contrasting with earlier disparities. The chart visualizes this trend with lines for Black, White, and Hispanic groups rising and converging between Feb 2021 and Aug 2021, with the title highlighting the similarity between Black and White adults.
